data.name: Purushotam
data.gender_notes: Purushotam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: He who possesses all (God). The name Purushotam carries the meaning “Lord of all” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Purushotam usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of all and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the supreme God, Vishnu, who is believed to be the preserver of the universe.
data.etymology: Purushotam belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of all.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Purushotam total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Purushotam" holds significant cultural resonance in Hinduism, as it is a compound Sanskrit word that denotes someone who embodies the highest ideals of godliness, morality, and virtuous living. It frames individuals named Purushotam as exemplars of spiritual aspirations, strived toward by many on the path of righteousness and self-realization.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Purushotam" lies in its revelation of the deep-rooted belief in the Hindu quest for the Divine Self. It is a confirmation that all beings ultimately hold the divine essence within, and by striving to embody the highest virtues, an individual can tap into that divine potential and attain a state of oneness with the universe.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Purushotam translates to 'Dearest to God', symbolizing an individual deeply devoted and surrendered to the divine, seeking to live a life pleasing to the Almighty.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Purushotam was a revered name for Vishnu in the Vaishnavite tradition. The name Purushotam carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

trends: The name Purushotam is gaining popularity as a given name in the Hindu community.
The name is also used as a title of respect for elders and spiritual leaders.
The name is used in various Hindu literary works and mythological stories.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Purushotam remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Priya Purushotam from Kathmandu, Nepal embodies the meaning of Purushotam - "Lord of all". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
